name: io.github.JoongHyuk-Shin/multigres-mcp
title: Multigres
description: Postgres diagnostics and cluster operations for Multigres clusters.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URI
environmentVariables.description: Postgres connection string of the Multigres gateway.

environmentVariables.name: MULTIGRES_ADMIN_URL
environmentVariables.description: multiadmin HTTP address. The cluster tools are registered only when it is set.

environmentVariables.name: MULTIGRES_ADMIN_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for multiadmin started with --enable-auth.

environmentVariables.name: MULTIGRES_NODE_HOST_MAP
environmentVariables.description: reported=reachable host pairs, comma separated, for direct node connections.

environmentVariables.name: MULTIGRES_MCP_ACCESS_MODE
environmentVariables.description: restricted (read-only) or unrestricted (adds the write tools).

environmentVariables.name: MULTIGRES_MCP_SQL_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Statement timeout for the SQL every tool sends, as a Go duration.
